title: C natural

nodes.title: C natural
nodes.body: One fingering. Set the fingers for G, then lift the top one. Coming from G, uncurling that finger slides into the note. Hear it, then hold it. If it will not seal, that is the remark. A second fingering waits until this one disagrees on this stick.

nodes.title: C inside a phrase
nodes.body: The same fingering, between notes you already have. If you arrive from G, let the top finger uncurl into it. Play from the start of the line.

source: One fingering that speaks on this whistle: the top hole open, the next two closed, the bottom three open. Checked once. No half-hole menu.
